Our Services

Professional plastering services across Greater London and Surrey

We provide a full range of plastering services for domestic and commercial clients across Greater London and Surrey. Every job is completed to the highest standard with clean, professional workmanship throughout.

01

Plastering & Skimming

Full room plastering for new builds, extensions, and renovations. Skim coats applied over existing plaster, plasterboard, or concrete to create a perfectly smooth surface. We also handle ceiling plastering, bulkheads, and alcoves. Whether you need one wall patched or an entire property plastered, we deliver a flawless, level finish ready for decoration.

02

Dry Lining

All aspects of dry line work including dot and dab, metal stud partitions, timber stud walls, and insulated plasterboard installation. We create clean, straight walls with perfect angles on every job. Ideal for new partitions, insulation upgrades, and preparing surfaces that aren't suitable for traditional wet plastering.

03

Colour Rendering

External colour rendering systems including silicone render, K-rend, and monocouche finishes. We transform property exteriors with a durable, weatherproof, and low-maintenance finish available in a wide range of colours. The result is a clean, modern look that lasts for years without repainting. We handle full preparation including beading, mesh, and base coats.

04

Damp Proofing

Specialist damp proofing treatments to protect your property long-term. We identify the root cause of the damp — whether it's rising damp, penetrating damp, or condensation — and apply the right solution. This includes injection damp proof courses, tanking, and replastering with specialist damp-resistant materials to prevent recurrence.

05

Artex Removal & Covering

Remove or skim over outdated Artex ceilings and textured wall coatings. Many properties still have Artex from the 70s, 80s, and 90s that looks tired and dated. We apply a smooth skim coat over the existing texture, completely transforming the ceiling or wall into a modern, clean finish without the mess and cost of full removal.

06

Wallpaper Stripping & Painting

Complete wallpaper removal and wall preparation, followed by replastering where needed and professional painting. We strip old wallpaper cleanly, repair any damage underneath, and leave your walls smooth and ready. If painting is required to complete the job, we can arrange that too — giving you a wall-to-wall service from start to finish.

07

Patch Repairs

Cracks, holes, blown plaster, and water damage repaired to an invisible standard. There's no need to replaster an entire wall when the issue is localised. We cut out the damaged area, prepare the surface properly, and patch it so you'd never know there was a problem. Quick, clean, and cost-effective.

08

Coving & Cornice

Supply and fitting of decorative coving, cornicing, and ceiling roses. The finishing touch that adds character and a sense of quality to any room. We fit coving neatly with clean mitred corners and fill all joints for a seamless result. Available in a range of styles from simple modern profiles to traditional ornate designs.

09

Commercial Plastering

Plastering and rendering for commercial properties including offices, shops, restaurants, and rental properties. We work efficiently to minimise disruption to your business and deliver results on schedule. Whether it's a landlord needing a property turned around between tenants or a shop fit-out, we handle it professionally.
